title: Riley Link Orange can't connect with dev branch
symptom: RileyLink Orange cannot connect with dev branch; state stuck at initialization of RileyLink. No permission request notification appears. Connection works with master branch.
cause: The problem is the RL check for permission before connect code, specifically in RileyLinkBLE.kt connectGattInternal where the condition uses >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S, causing the permission request not to appear on Android 12.
fix: Change the condition in RileyLinkBLE.kt from `if (config.PUMPDRIVERS && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S && ...` to `if (config.PUMPDRIVERS && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT > Build.VERSION_CODES.S && ...` to bypass the permission check and allow connection.
evidence_quote: It's the RL check for permission before connect code the problem https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/b1d45833c5570910142e78ba39a8322b4039a9d5
